True or false: during the final stages of the hyperinflation, cigarettes became widely accepted as a medium of exchange.

body.question: A loaf of bread in Berlin cost around 160 marks at the end of 1922. What did it cost by late 1923?
body.reveal: A loaf of bread in Berlin that cost around 160 marks at the end of 1922 cost 200 billion marks by late 1923.
